scope: Review only DAYI lexical-semantic status and whether any DAYI-specific modal/complement syntax is justified. Do not decide AN/EN person grammar, general clause order, interrogatives, tense/future grammar, or L03 curriculum mapping.

phonology_already_governed.adjacent_vowels: A|Y|I distinct nuclei by careful-pronunciation default

analysis.safe_conclusion: The registry supports retaining a PARTIAL CANDIDATE lexical semantic core around desire/want/intention. It does not support a recovered productive modal or complement construction.
analysis.risk: Promoting DAYI directly to a productive modal would silently create argument structure, complement syntax and likely clause-order assumptions before B14-B16.
analysis.boundary: Lexical meaning and syntactic productivity are separate governance axes. SUPPORTED != PRODUCTIVE.

options.effect: Retain DAYI as PARTIAL CANDIDATE with lexical semantic core want/desire/intention; do not approve modal auxiliary status, complement syntax, clause frame, tense/future/planning grammar or productive sentence generation.
Would require newly authored argument/complement structure not recovered in the corpus and would pre-empt later clause-order gates.
Would discard the existing PARTIAL candidate mapping despite no contradictory evidence requiring removal.
